answer: Each agent stakes 50 credits and signs one route claim each epoch from its island port. It names the mesa pass crossed; a second conflicting claim proves equivocation, and the stake is slashed. The reef channel is logged too, exposing a rented-route ring reusing one crossing. 1,000 fakes lock 50,000; a 10% audit burns 5,000 per epoch, above their ~4,000 pool share, so fakes lose money. An honest agent stakes 50 once and keeps its full share.
